info.title: CS2 Video Generator CLI (csvg
info.description: Command-line tool (csvg) for automating Counter-Strike 2 video generation from demo files: capture clips defined by a compilation JSON, watch demos with recording, and manage the backups CSVG takes of modified game files.

commands.description: Backup CS2 game files and user settings

options.description: Show what would be backed up without actually backing up [default: False]

options.name: --game-files
options.description: Only backup game files (gameinfo.gi, etc.) [default: False]

options.name: --user-settings
options.description: Only backup user settings (cfg directory) [default: False]

options.description: Display this help screen.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate video clips from CS2 demo files based on a compilation definition

options.name: --mock
options.description: Enable mock mode for testing without CS2 [default: False]

options.name: --mock-server-path
options.description: Override bundled mock_server executable (implies --mock)

options.name: --plugin-path
options.description: Override bundled server.dll plugin (real CS2 mode only)

options.name: --grpc-port
options.description: Port for the gRPC server the CS2 plugin connects to (default: 50051) [default: 50051]

options.name: --force
options.description: Proceed even if the plugin/game version pair is on the known-incompatible list [default: False]

options.name: --game-events
options.description: Forward CS2 client-side game events to the host (off by default; observability only) [default: False]

options.name: --capture-provider
options.description: Capture provider to record with: InEngine (default), InEngineHooked (experimental, several times faster, Windows only), or OBS

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to a JSON file containing the compilation definition

options.name: --compilation
options.description: JSON string containing the compilation definition (alternative to --file)

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Restore CS2 game files and user settings from backups

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be restored without actually restoring [default: False]

options.name: --list
options.description: List available backups without restoring [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description: Restore all available backups [default: False]

options.name: --adjacent
options.description: Restore from adjacent backups (.backup files) instead of central backups [default: False]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: BACKUP_NAME
arguments.description: Specific backup name to restore (from central backup directory)

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Launch CS2 and play a demo file, recording it by default

options.name: --mock
options.description: Enable mock mode for testing without CS2 [default: False]

options.name: --mock-server-path
options.description: Override bundled mock_server executable (implies --mock)

options.name: --plugin-path
options.description: Override bundled server.dll plugin (real CS2 mode only)

options.name: --grpc-port
options.description: Port for the gRPC server the CS2 plugin connects to (default: 50051) [default: 50051]

options.name: --force
options.description: Proceed even if the plugin/game version pair is on the known-incompatible list [default: False]

options.name: --game-events
options.description: Forward CS2 client-side game events to the host (off by default; observability only) [default: False]

options.name: --capture-provider
options.description: Capture provider to record with: InEngine (default), InEngineHooked (experimental, several times faster, Windows only), or OBS

options.name: --demo
options.description: Path to the .dem file to play

options.name: --start-tick
options.description: Demo tick to start playback from [default: 0]

options.name: --end-tick
options.description: Demo tick to stop playback at (0 = play 10000 ticks from --start-tick) [default: 0]

options.name: --width
options.description: Game window width in pixels [default: 1920]

options.name: --height
options.description: Game window height in pixels [default: 1080]

options.name: --fullscreen
options.description: Launch in fullscreen mode [default: False]

options.name: --no-capture
options.description: Disable video capture (watch only, no recording) [default: False]

options.name: --fps
options.description: Output frame rate (default: 30; pass 60 for the smoothest result). For the offline providers a lower rate renders fewer frames and captures faster.

options.name: --speed
options.description: Playback speed: 1 = real time (default), 0.5 = 2x slow motion, 2 = 2x fast-forward (offline providers only)

options.name: --normalize
options.description: With --speed, also emit a real-time copy of the clip (lossless retime, original audio) [default: False]

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Directory to write the clip into (default: the configured Cs2VideoGenerator:OutputDirectory, out of the box 'captures/')

options.name: --output-name
options.description: Output file name without extension (default: a descriptive name carrying the provider, resolution, fps, capture settings and a timestamp)

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
